def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 2]
    minr = min(r for r, c in points)
    minc = min(c for r, c in points)
    shape = {(r-minr, c-minc) for r, c in points}
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sh = max(r for r, c in shape) + 1
    sw = max(c for r, c in shape) + 1
    for r0 in range(h-sh+1):
        for c0 in range(w-sw+1):
            cells = [(r0+dr, c0+dc) for dr, dc in shape]
            if all(grid[r][c] == 0 for r, c in cells):
                for r, c in cells:
                    g[r][c] = 2
    return g
PY

cat > programs/task-e151c1a0.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker = next(v for v, _ in counts.most_common() if v != background)
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == marker]
    minr = min(r for r, c in points)
    minc = min(c for r, c in points)
    shape = {(r-minr, c-minc) for r, c in points}
    sh = max(r for r, c in shape) + 1
    sw = max(c for r, c in shape) + 1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0 in range(h-sh+1):
        for c0 in range(w-sw+1):
            cells = [(r0+dr, c0+dc) for dr, dc in shape]
            if all(grid[r][c] == 0 for r, c in cells):
                for r, c in cells:
                    out[r][c] = marker
    return out
PY
